BETA Close X CRH plc announced the repurchase of 145,031 ordinary shares on March 12, 2026, for an aggregate volume-weighted average price of $100.4558 per share, with individual trades ranging from $99.32 to $102.45. These repurchases are part of CRH's plan to buy back up to $300 million in shares by April 28, 2026, following an announcement on February 18, 2026. Following these transactions and subsequent cancellation, CRH will have 669,154,192 ordinary shares in issue, with 35,643,874 shares held in treasury, representing 5.057% of the issued ordinary share capital. Disclaimer* 13 th March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 12 th March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled.
